"""Field-season Gantt chart with plotly.express.timeline. Tasks are given as (label, row, start_day, duration_days) relative to day 0, so re-planning only means editing the TASKS list or START_DATE. """ from datetime import date, timedelta import pandas as pd import plotly.express as px TITLE = "Season 1, 27/28" START_DATE = date(2027, 1, 4) # placeholder: day 0 of the season N_WEEKS = 4 # label, row (tasks sharing a row sit on one line), start day, duration (days) TASKS = [ ("Input from UG", "Logistics", 0, 3), ("Establish camp", "Logistics", 3, 3), ("Decamp /
depot kit", "Logistics", 22, 3), ("Uplift to UG", "Logistics", 25, 3), ("Setup RAID", "RAID setup", 5, 3), ("Drill RAID hole (O2)", "Drilling", 8, 12), ("Image hole (O4)", "Borehole instrumentation", 20, 2), ("Install
DTS (O5)", "Borehole instrumentation", 22, 2), ("ApRES
survey (O3)", "Geophysics", 7, 3), ("Active seismic survey (O3)", "Geophysics",10, 10), ] ROW_ORDER = ["Logistics", "RAID setup", "Drilling", "Borehole instrumentation", "Geophysics"] BAR = "#6b8aa3" EDGE = "#1b2b3a" HEADER = "#2e5f80" df = pd.DataFrame(TASKS, columns=["Task", "Row", "StartDay", "Days"]) df["Start"] = pd.to_datetime([START_DATE + timedelta(days=d) for d in df.StartDay]) df["Finish"] = df.Start + pd.to_timedelta(df.Days, unit="D") fig = px.timeline( df, x_start="Start", x_end="Finish", y="Row", text="Task", category_orders={"Row": ROW_ORDER}, ) fig.update_traces( marker=dict(color=BAR, line=dict(color=EDGE, width=2)), textposition="inside", insidetextanchor="middle", textfont=dict(color="white", size=13), hovertemplate="%{text}
%{base|%d %b} – %{x|%d %b}", ) season_end = pd.Timestamp(START_DATE + timedelta(weeks=N_WEEKS)) # Alternating row bands for i, _ in enumerate(ROW_ORDER): fig.add_hrect(y0=i - 0.5, y1=i + 0.5, layer="below", line_width=1, fillcolor="#d5dbe0" if i % 2 == 0 else "#e8ecef") # Week headers along the top for w in range(N_WEEKS): x0 = pd.Timestamp(START_DATE + timedelta(weeks=w)) x1 = x0 + pd.Timedelta(weeks=1) fig.add_shape(type="rect", xref="x", yref="paper", x0=x0, x1=x1, y0=1.0, y1=1.20, fillcolor=HEADER, line=dict(color="black", width=2)) fig.add_annotation(xref="x", yref="paper", x=x0 + (x1 - x0) / 2, y=1.14, text=f"Week {w + 1}", showarrow=False, font=dict(color="white", size=14)) fig.update_xaxes( range=[pd.Timestamp(START_DATE), season_end], dtick=86400000.0, # one gridline per day showticklabels=False, # hide the day numbers showgrid=True, gridcolor="black", gridwidth=1, title=None, ) fig.update_yaxes(title=None, showgrid=False) fig.update_yaxes(title=None, showgrid=False, ticklabelstandoff=5) fig.update_layout( title=dict(text=TITLE, x=0.55, xanchor="center", y=1, font=dict(size=22)), plot_bgcolor="white", paper_bgcolor="white", height=300, width=1200, margin=dict(l=110, r=20, t=70, b=10), showlegend=False, font=dict(family="Arial"), bargap=0, # bars fill the full height of each row band ) if __name__ == "__main__": fig.write_html("season1_gantt.html") # Static export needs `pip install kaleido` try: fig.write_image("season1_gantt.png", scale=2) except Exception as e: print("PNG export skipped:", e) fig.show()
